chapter: Duke, Eddie Lang and other guitarists
title: Jealousy with Doug Daniels and the pot-rolling nights with Leo
summary: Doug Daniels would not share solos with Bunn's six strings, and he and Leo rolled pot all night.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Yeah, that's right. Yeah. Just like the fellow I had working with me, playing tipple. Doug Daniels, God bless him, rest his soul. But I mean him and me got in a fight about it because I wanted my solo and he's single stringing, picking the single string. You've heard him, haven't you?
Uh-huh. Yeah.

He had good knowledge of his instrument, but yet and still he didn't want nobody else to take it but him. Jealousy. And that's wrong. Here I've got six strings and he's got four. So naturally I'm going to get out of my six more than he's going to get out of his four. That's the understanding that he should have had right there. Because six strings is more than four.
Well, Doug was getting a lot of attention anyway, wasn't he? Because he --
Yeah, he was getting a lot of attention.
He did the lead vocals a lot of times.
Yeah, he was getting a lot of attention.
And he was good looking too, wasn't he?
That's right. A nice looking boy.
Yeah.
Nice hair and everything. But no, that jealousy got onto him. And he was smoking that pot, too. Shit, him and Leo used to go down and get cans and bottles of pot, you know, cans. Flour barrels.
Large amounts.
(Laughter)

[Yeah, he would.] I sat in a room one night with him and just watched him. And him and Leo -- God rest his soul -- and him and Leo, boy, got in one room. Let me tell you this. Got in one room and rolled pot all night long, from 10:00 o'clock at night until the next morning at 9:00 o'clock in the morning. All night long, he's rolling. Some big ones, some small ones, some little ones. Roaches.
Uh-huh.
They'd be smoking, and the more they smoked the more they rolled.
(Laughter)
Yeah, God rest his soul. Leo died out
here, you know.
Yeah.
Yeah.
Yeah, we talked about that the other day.
Yeah, he was a good boy.
